# T-3: Add log retrieval command

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add sdd-forge flow get runtime-log so agents can retrieve the latest or selected runtime log block without reading files directly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Default output prints the selected block as raw text.
- --format json returns an envelope with text and metadata.
- --sequence and --run-id <runId>#<sequence> select requested blocks with non-zero error envelopes for invalid or missing targets.
- No active flow defaults to .tmp/logs/no-flow.log.

## Implementation Notes
Add registry entry and parser/reader for the per-flow block log. Validate user-facing arguments at the entry point.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for argument validation, missing files, missing sequences, raw output, and JSON output.
